A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Malsuum]]. During the battle, a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi General|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] charge but was killed by an explosion. [[Hock Malsuum|CT-5539]] picked up her body and rallied [[Red Team (Galactic Republic)|Red]] and [[Blue Team (Galactic Republic)|Blue Teams]] against [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Later CT-5539 was aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] with a [[Unidentified Zabrak Jedi General|Zabrak General]]. CT-5539 was hit by a laser bolt and fell from the [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. He survived and remained on the planet for more than two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until he left to find the great warrior [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Cry of Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears in the flashback portion of the [[2013]] [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] comic [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 1|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 1]].
